entities.summary: Daniel Philip Meuser is an American businessman and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 9th congressional district since 2019. A Republican, he previously served as the secretary of revenue in the cabinet of Pennsylvania governor Tom Corbett. He was previously president of the Pride Corporation, a manufacturer of motorized wheelchairs in the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton metro area of Pennsylvania, and currently serves the company as a board member and consultant. He has testified before Congress regarding the criticality for federal practices surrounding rights and caring for the disabled.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in Pennsylvania's government and business sectors, Dan Meuser has had significant regional impact through his roles as secretary of revenue and president of the Pride Corporation. His testimony before Congress on disability rights matters highlights the importance of federal practices surrounding these issues.
